snippets.snippet_text: "At Hotmart, you can create your account, register your digital products, and start using our tools for promotion and sales without any initial cost. Platform fees are only charged when you make a sale."

"In the scenario where the purchase currency is different from the commission currency, the transaction value is converted into US dollars (USD) to perform the calculations." And: "Important: in all the scenarios described above, the evaluated value does not include taxes and credit card fee."
"Are there different fees for different legal entities? There are no different fees for accounts with different legal entities." And: "Are buyers charged platform usage fees? No."

possible_subjects: Hotmart help article on fees (no visible date): no setup cost; platform fees charged per sale only; multi-currency purchases converted to USD for fee calculation; fees exclude taxes and credit card charges; no fee differences by legal entity type; buyers not charged platform usage fees
